2017_statement: OFR introduced the current FSI among two new tools and announced daily updates. This establishes a hard caution for treating the current CSV backhistory 2000-2017 as a historically tradeable current-method signal.
2014_context: An earlier OFR FSI existed in 2014 using a rolling principal-component description; this does not certify identity of the current 33-variable FSI historical backfill or exact old funding subcomponent values.
major_revision: The official 2023 workbook documents old/new FSI and Funding values for 382 dates 2022-01-03..2023-06-23. Funding median absolute change 0.307337, maximum 0.763905. Updated workbook values exactly match current CSV on those dates up to floating precision.
conservative_scope: No full 2011-2022 current-FSI Stage1 allocation feature or account is qualified. A separate 2018-2022 10:32 recovery-action source map may be researched conditionally using OFR release lag and documented old-versus-new values, but first-public individual daily source and 2026 corrections remain unqualified.
